posts.text: image 1179×1395 166 KB Recently, transrail won an order for HTLS reconductoring project for this D/C line and powergrid has raised its capex. Many reconductoring tenders have already been floated and with TBCB winning multiple projects in various states recently will open doors for HTLS conductors in coming months. Another multiyear growth opportunity for transrail is GEC(III) project recently announced by GOI . Next 4-5 years look attractive for transrail in terms of order pipeline
